description: This PHP source file defines the class HTMLPurifier_CSSDefinition, which specifies allowed CSS attributes and their potential values for the HTML Purifier library. It constructs the set of CSS properties that the purifier permits, including various CSS properties, their data types, and setup configurations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_CSSDefinition
classes.description: Defines allowed CSS attributes and their values for use in HTML purification, constructing the set of permissible CSS properties based on configuration settings.

methods.name: doSetup
methods.description: Initializes the CSS properties info array with permissible CSS attributes and their definitions, configuring properties based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: doSetupProprietary
methods.description: Sets up proprietary CSS properties specific to certain browsers or vendor-specific extensions, such as Internet Explorer scrollbar colors and vendor prefixes.

methods.name: doSetupTricky
methods.description: Adds CSS properties to handle tricky or less common CSS features, like display types, opacity, and visibility.

methods.name: doSetupTrusted
methods.description: Configures properties that are considered trusted, such as positioning and z-index, based on security settings.

methods.name: setupConfigStuff
methods.description: Performs additional configuration-based processing, enabling or disabling properties based on allowed and forbidden properties in the configuration.
